chunks: Zurarah and Muḥammad ibn Muslim narrated from Abī Jaʿfar عليه السلام that he said:
"It suffices the one who is confused, at all times, whichever direction he turns, if he does not know where the direction of the qiblah is."

key_terms.أَيْنَمَا تَوَجَّهَ: whichever direction he turns or faces
key_terms.الْمُتَحَيِّرَ: the person who is confused or uncertain
key_terms.يُجْزِي: it suffices or is valid for fulfilling the requirement

ai.seo_question: What should someone do in salat if they do not know the direction of the qiblah?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling for a person who is uncertain about the direction of the qiblah. If he truly does not know its direction, his prayer is valid in whichever direction he faces.
